Northwind Analytics — Employee Handbook (excerpt)

Annual leave. Full-time employees accrue 1.5 days of annual leave per month, for a total of 18 days per year. Up to 5 unused days may be carried into the next year.

Remote work. Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with their manager's agreement.

Equipment. Company laptops must use full-disk encryption and must not be left unattended in vehicles.
